input: Research shared allotment plots near me

gold.taskTitle: Research shared allotment plots near my location
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate shared allotment plot options available in the user's local area.

questions.title: What town, city, or postcode should we search around?
questions.description: Identify the specific location to use as the base for searching nearby allotment plots.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to the plot?
questions.description: Establish the maximum acceptable distance or travel time from home to the allotment.

questions.title: Do you want a shared plot or your own private one?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user specifically wants to share a single plot with others, or is open to a private allotment.

questions.title: What is your main reason for wanting an allotment?
questions.description: Understand the core motivation, such as growing vegetables, mental wellbeing, community connection, or learning.

questions.title: Do you have a budget in mind for annual plot fees?
questions.description: Determine any cost constraints that would filter out certain allotment sites or schemes.

questions.title: How much time per week can you commit to the plot?
questions.description: Gauge availability so suitable plot sizes and sharing arrangements can be matched accordingly.

questions.title: Do you have any prior gardening or growing experience?
questions.description: Assess skill level to determine whether beginner-friendly or mentored allotment schemes should be prioritised.
